name: Elevator Bank
description: Six elevator doors stand in a row, each leading to a different dimensional floor. Helpful labels read: '1-Ghost Floor', '2-Cyber Casino', '3-Fantasy Realm', '4-Alien Convention', 'B-Basement', and one that just says 'YES'. The call buttons glow with impossible colors. One elevator keeps arriving before you push the button. A sign warns: 'Please do not attempt to exist on multiple floors simultaneously. Management is not responsible for temporal paradoxes, existential crises, or being your own grandfather.'
